items.title: Improve app_connectivity
items.rationale: 95% of users experienced issues with app connectivity, which is the most frequently mentioned problem.

items.title: Enhance setup process
items.rationale: 94% of users had difficulties with the setup process, which is a significant pain point.

items.title: Address customer service concerns
items.rationale: 43% of users had negative experiences with customer service, indicating a need for improvement.

items.title: Optimize battery life
items.rationale: 7% of users experienced battery-related issues, which is a common problem.

items.title: Improve accuracy and range
items.rationale: 55% and 11% of users experienced issues with accuracy and range, respectively, which are key features of the product.
